reason: We already pay a tuition teacher who sits with my child in person, and that is where I trust the learning happens. I'll read the free report and pass it to the tutor, but I'm not adding another app and more screen time on top.
objection: More screen time is the last thing my child needs, and an app can't sit beside them and make sure they actually understand the way a teacher does.
would_change_my_mind: If the school itself made it part of homework and our tuition teacher used the gap report and practice with my child, so it replaced some work rather than adding screen time.
